preprocessing: RGB decode; same cached normalized person ROI per unit; INTER_AREA resize to 171x128; crop y8:120 x29:141; float32/255; established Kinetics mean/std; generic model fc=Identity; L2-normalize float32 output.
physical_time_convention: Frame i occupies [i/fps,(i+1)/fps). Window starts at its first sampled frame, stops after its last sampled frame, and center is the midpoint. Normalized times divide by frame_count/fps. No cross-modality time correction is performed.
missing_encoding: Full unit/modality/window grid; missing X rows are zero with available=false and alignment_ok=false. Missing frame indices/times are -1; fps/frame_count/duration are zero. Consumers must apply the masks.
restrictions: Only generic Kinetics weights, official videos/QA metadata, and image-derived YOLO ROI caches; no K-KUNO classifier, logits, test labels, or stored prediction table. This is feature extraction only, not temporal training.
